q: How do I generate an image?
a: Navigate to the main workspace, choose Image as your creative type, enter your prompt, pick an aspect ratio, and click Generate. Required credits are reserved upfront.

q: Why was my generation charged even though it failed?
a: Credits are temporarily reserved when starting. If a job fails or times out, reservations are automatically released or refunded. Check your wallet ledger in Settings → Billing.

q: Can I download my generated assets?
a: Yes! Open any asset from the Asset Library (/assets) and click Download. Bounded derivatives are served in the UI, but original media is exported intact.

q: How do I top up my credits?
a: Go to Settings → Billing and record a payment or contact your workspace finance admin. 1 credit = 1 baisa.

Aiwa Creator supports models across providers: BytePlus Seedream 3.0 (images), MegaCreator/Wan (video), Seed-TTS 2.0 (voice), OmniHuman 1.5 (talking avatars), and Groq ultra-fast LPU models (GPT-OSS 20B/120B).
